description: Map layers used by research/freshwater/assets/map.js. Public layers are requested live from the provider's service (nothing large is copied into this repository). Every layer states provider, dataset, version, resolution, coverage and known limitations. check_status records the last time a tile or image was successfully requested from the service near Allen Branch.

default_view.note: Every portal map is centered on 808 Monticello Street, Somerset Community College's main-campus address, as located by the Kentucky 911 Site Structure Address Points. The zoom is then set so that the whole mapped Allen Branch line fits around that center.

records.name: USGS Topo
records.provider: U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map
records.dataset: USGS Topo cached base map (USGSTopo MapServer)
records.resolution: Multi-scale cartographic base map; detailed to about 1:9,000
records.limitations: Cartographic generalization: lines are drawn for legibility, not survey accuracy. Roads and names come from several national datasets of different dates.

records.name: Kentucky road map (Commonwealth Map)
records.provider: Commonwealth of Kentucky, Division of Geographic Information (KyGovMaps)
records.dataset: The Commonwealth Map — street base map (Ky_TCM_Street_Base_WGS84WM)
records.resolution: Multi-scale road map; street names and building outlines at close zoom
records.limitations: A cartographic road map for orientation and directions. Road and route data come from state and local sources; it does not show private roads, access permission, or which roads reach the creek.

records.name: OpenStreetMap (streets, businesses & places)
records.dataset: OpenStreetMap standard map tiles
records.limitations: Community-mapped. In Somerset, business coverage is partial — some places are named (for example near campus: the Courtyard hotel and The Center for Rural Development) but many buildings have no name. For complete business listings, hours and Street View, use the 'Open in Google Maps' button on the map. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License.

records.name: USGS Imagery
records.provider: U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map (USDA orthoimagery)
records.dataset: USGS Imagery Only cached base map
records.limitations: Leaf-on summer imagery hides narrow shaded streams under canopy. Imagery date varies by tile.

records.name: Imagery with roads & labels
records.provider: U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map
records.dataset: USGS Imagery Topo cached base map (orthoimagery with US Topo roads, names and contours)
records.limitations: Leaf-on imagery can hide narrow shaded channels; road and name overlays are generalized for legibility.

records.name: Kentucky aerial imagery 2022 (2 ft)
records.provider: Commonwealth of Kentucky, Division of Geographic Information (KyGovMaps); imagery from USDA NAIP
records.dataset: Ky_Imagery_2022_2FT_WGS84WM (layer Ky_NAIP_2022_2FT_WM)
records.limitations: Single growing-season acquisition; canopy obscures small channels; not a substitute for field confirmation of flow or channel location.

records.name: Terrain — KyFromAbove hillshade (5 ft)
records.dataset: Ky_MultiDirectional_Hillshade_WGS84WM (from Ky_DEM_KYAPED_5FT)
records.limitations: Shaded relief shows landforms (valleys, sinkholes, road fills) but no elevation values; it does not show where water flows underground.

records.name: Highways & roads
records.provider: U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map
records.dataset: National Transportation Dataset (transportation MapServer): interstates, U.S. and state routes with route shields; local roads at closer zoom
records.version: Service built from U.S. Census TIGER/Line and U.S. Forest Service road data
records.resolution: Scale-dependent: major highways at regional zoom, local roads when zoomed in
records.limitations: Transparent overlay meant to sit on imagery, terrain or any base map. Road centerlines are generalized and may lag recent construction; the map says nothing about legal access to the creek.
records.attribution: USGS The National Map; U.S. Census TIGER/Line

records.name: Streams & waterbodies (NHD)
records.dataset: National Hydrography Dataset, high resolution (nhd MapServer) — streams, waterbodies, and karst features: springs/seeps and sinks/rises (points) and underground conduits (lines)
records.limitations: Mapped features, not field surveys. Perennial/intermittent/ephemeral classes come from map compilation and may not match current flow. Small headwater channels are often missing. Springs, sinks and underground conduits are shown only where they have been mapped; a conduit line shows a mapped connection, not its exact underground route, and unmapped karst connections are common.

records.name: Watershed boundaries (HUC 8 / 10 / 12)
records.dataset: Watershed Boundary Dataset (wbd MapServer, layers 4–6)
records.limitations: Hydrologic units are surface-topography units; a 12-digit unit is not the drainage basin of any particular small stream. In karst, groundwater can cross these boundaries.

records.name: Bedrock geology (geologic map)
records.dataset: KY24KGeologicFormations_WGS84 — 1:24,000 geologic quadrangle data (1:500,000 map at regional zoom)
records.version: Digitized 1996–2006 from 707 USGS/KGS geologic quadrangle maps published 1960–1980; Allen Branch lies on the Delmer (GQ-909) and Somerset (GQ-1196) quadrangles
records.resolution: 1:24,000 when zoomed in; 1:500,000 at regional zoom
records.limitations: Map units and contacts are geologists' interpretations from field mapping decades ago; contacts are approximate, and the map shows bedrock, not soil or groundwater paths. Select 'About' for the source quadrangle maps.

records.name: Land cover — NLCD 2021
records.dataset: Ky_Landcover_NLCD21_WGS84WM
records.limitations: 30-m pixels cannot resolve a narrow riparian corridor. 'Pasture/Hay' and 'Cultivated Crops' classes describe land cover, not management, fertilizer use or livestock density, and say nothing about whether runoff reaches a stream. No land-cover percentages are calculated on this site until a basin is properly delineated.

records.name: Karst potential (1:500,000)
records.dataset: KY500KKarstPotential_WGS84 — 1988 Geologic Map of Kentucky formations styled by karst potential
records.limitations: Regional generalization from a 1:500,000 map; boundaries can be off by hundreds of meters and must not be used to judge a single site.

records.name: Mapped sinkholes
records.dataset: KYSinkholes — sinkhole outlines digitized from topographic contours
records.limitations: Only depressions large enough to show on topographic contours are mapped; many small or filled sinkholes are missing.

records.name: Springs (Kentucky Groundwater Data Repository)
records.provider: Kentucky Geological Survey (data from the Kentucky Division of Water)
records.dataset: KYSprings
records.limitations: Only springs that have been reported to the repository; locations vary in accuracy.

records.name: Dye traces & karst groundwater basins
records.dataset: KYGWKarstBasins — dye injection and recovery sites, traced groundwater flow paths, and interpreted karst groundwater basins
records.resolution: Point sites; flow paths connect injection to recovery sites; basin boundaries interpreted from multiple traces
records.coverage: Kentucky areas where dye tracing has been done
records.limitations: A traced flow path shows that dye travelled from one place to another, not the exact underground route. KGS notes that flow paths can shift at high flow, basins can overlap, and the dataset does not guarantee the accuracy of flow paths or basin boundaries. Areas without traces are unknown, not unconnected.

records.name: Wastewater plants & outfalls
records.dataset: Ky_Wastewater_WGS84WM (layers: Wastewater Treatment Plants, Package Treatment Plants, WWTP Outfalls)
records.limitations: Wastewater infrastructure inventory, not the complete list of discharge permits (KPDES). Industrial, stormwater and agricultural permits are not shown. A nearby facility does not establish that it affects a given stream.

records.name: USGS stream gages
records.dataset: Ky_USGS_Gages_WGS84WM
records.limitations: Includes inactive as well as active gages; check USGS Water Data for current status. No gage is mapped on Allen Branch.

records.name: Water-quality monitoring locations (WQP)
records.dataset: Station search, HUC 051301030204 — saved extract data/geo/monitoring-locations.geojson
records.resolution: Point locations as reported by each organization
records.limitations: Registered monitoring locations, not proof of current or recent sampling. Kentucky Division of Water sites appear twice (21KY and 21KY_WQX). None is on Allen Branch.

records.name: Allen Branch — NHD centerline & flow direction
records.dataset: data/geo/allen-branch-nhd.geojson — Allen Branch (GNIS 00485848) and mapped downstream reaches
records.coverage: Allen Branch and Sinking Creek to the Pitman Creek artificial path
records.limitations: Status: Mapped — not field-verified. Arrows follow NHD's digitized flow direction. The intermittent classification and the downstream connection have not been confirmed in the field, and karst may divert flow underground.

records.name: 808 Monticello Street — campus center point
records.provider: Kentucky 911 Services Board (record maintained by Pulaski County 911), via KyGovMaps
records.dataset: Kentucky 911 Site Structure Address Points — saved extract data/geo/campus-reference.geojson
records.resolution: Single address point (placement method not stated in the record)
records.limitations: Locates the campus street address and is the center point of every map. It is not the creek access point, not a sampling station, and not field-confirmed. The U.S. Census Geocoder places the same address 268 m to the northwest; the 911 address point is used instead.

records.name: Distance circles from campus (0.5, 1, 2 km)
records.provider: Biology at SCC (drawn around the campus address point)
records.dataset: Circles of fixed radius centered on 808 Monticello Street
records.limitations: Straight-line distance only. The circles are an orientation aid, not a study-area boundary, a watershed, a walking distance or an access route.

records.name: Field observation points
records.dataset: data/observations.json (published records only)
records.resolution: GPS position recorded with each observation, with stated accuracy
records.limitations: Empty until the first field visit is recorded and reviewed.

not_available.reason: No public statewide culvert inventory was found. Roads appear on the USGS Topo base map; culverts on Allen Branch need a field inventory.

not_available.layer: Upstream drainage area of Allen Branch
not_available.reason: Not yet delineated. To be produced with USGS StreamStats (or lidar-based delineation in QGIS) and stored with its method and date.
Not available as a public layer found so far; requires municipal records or field inventory.
The wastewater layer above is an infrastructure inventory, not the full permit list. EPA ECHO facility search is the next source to integrate.
None established yet. Stations will be added after field reconnaissance with GPS coordinates and stated accuracy.
